entries.summary: Introduced governance/change_log.json as a passive, non-enforcing per-repo change tracker (federation-wide rollout across all seven repos). It documents changes only; nothing reads or validates it, and nothing in CI depends on its contents. Prompted by removing a repo-wide change-freeze that existed in moneysweep-pr and ovnis-pr's unified-skillpack conformance checks and blocked ordinary PRs; this repo never had that freeze.

Adopted the change-coupled documentation gate defined by thehub-pr ADR 0010: the shared tools/check_docs_sync.py, a docs-sync workflow, a Claude Code Stop hook, CLAUDE.md, and this repo's .federation/docs-sync.json. Re-pinned PRII_TEMPLATE_REF to thehub-pr 09e2e54, which carries the checker's fix for path:symbol references and the prii-desktop pin bump in requirements-desktop.txt (a desktop startup failure now shows an error screen instead of hanging Setup). Tooling and workflow change plus that pin bump: no contract, schema or dependency edge changed. PROVISIONAL until docs-sync is a required status check on main.

Re-pinned PRII_TEMPLATE_REF to thehub-pr 4258c3c, which hardens the shared docs-sync checker (thehub-pr#359): a pull request can no longer exempt itself through exempt_authors, manifest hygiene is judged on the head manifest so retiring a coupling or renaming a coupled doc no longer fails, a glob that matches nothing now fails when the change adds it, and a :symbol or :line locator is dropped from Markdown link targets. CONTRIBUTING.md now states what the gate enforces. The manifest comment now says a coupling fires on its on events, and exempt_docs now lists docs/adr/** as the comment already claimed. The shared eslint config also picked up one optional glob (src/zip-design, thehub-pr#358); that directory holds no JavaScript here, so lint coverage is unchanged. Tooling and documentation change only: no contract, schema or dependency edge changed.
